roleTitle: Healthcare Account Management & Client Strategy | Experience First

job.rawJd:
General recruiter and networking profile, not an employer posting.

Target: healthcare and pharmaceutical agency account management, client strategy, and adjacent client-services roles.

Core work: own client relationships; manage budgets, briefs, timelines, national broadcast and integrated campaign delivery, cross-functional teams, FDA preclearance, and med-legal and MLR review; use research and campaign performance to guide client recommendations; bring later UX, enterprise analytics, and regulated AI experience back into account leadership.

Resume architecture: lead with direct Account Management Experience, then show Recent & Complementary Experience without duplicating or removing any role.

This package must be fit-gated again against each employer's actual job description before application.

classification.primarySource: The resume is the main evidence. It leads with 7+ years of direct Fortune 500 pharma and healthcare account management, $2M-$50M+ budgets, national television launches, FDA and med-legal review, digital and loyalty programs, and cross-functional delivery.
classification.supportingSource: The portfolio shows how later UX, analytics, and regulated AI work strengthened client discovery, workflow judgment, and delivery. It supports the return story without replacing the direct account-management evidence.

fitGate.recommendation: Proceed with the experience-first version as the direct account-management resume. Lead with the account work recruiters need to see, then use recent UX, analytics, and AI experience as complementary proof. Re-run the fit gate for every employer.
